# skills-install

> One command to install AI agent skills into Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini.

skills-install is a free, zero-dependency Node.js CLI. It auto-detects which AI coding agents are installed on the machine, pulls a skill (a folder containing SKILL.md) from GitHub or a local path, and copies it into the correct skills directory.

## Install

Requires Node.js 18 or newer.

    npm install -g github:clements23/skills-install

Or run ad hoc without installing:

    npx -y github:clements23/skills-install owner/repo

## Supported agents and skills directories

- Claude Code: ~/.claude/skills/
- OpenAI Codex: ~/.codex/skills/
- Cursor: ~/.cursor/skills/
- Gemini CLI: ~/.gemini/skills/

Use --project to install into the current repository instead, or --all-agents to install into every detected agent.

## Options

- --agent <name>: target a specific agent
- --project: install into the current project directory
- --all-agents: install into every detected agent
- --force: overwrite an existing skill
- --dry-run: preview without copying

## Source formats

- GitHub shorthand: owner/repo
- Full GitHub URL
- Local directory containing SKILL.md
- Local directory containing a skills/ folder of skill packages
- A single SKILL.md file

## Related tools

- agent-guardrail-skill: safety guardrails for coding agents, https://github.com/clements23/agent-guardrail-skill
